message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No newly reported vulnerabilities were confirmed for the deduplicated components in `DLL_software_component.txt` during the 24-hour window from 2026-09-26 07:40 UTC to 2026-09-27 07:40 UTC.

### Findings

No candidate met all inclusion requirements: credible sourcing, a supported match to the assigned DLL/component scope, and first disclosure or a material security update within the scan window.

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The mandatory dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, and major MongoDB-maintained libraries and services. No qualifying MongoDB-family advisory was found. PyMongo items surfaced in current vulnerability feeds were dated September 24 and were excluded as outside the window.

### Source and freshness review

The [GitHub Advisory Database](https://github.com/advisories) was checked for current NuGet and npm disclosures, together with vendor/advisory searches for the commercial and open-source components in the assigned file. The [official MongoDB alerts page](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts), MongoDB project advisories, CISA-oriented searches, and current CVE reporting were also checked. Matches outside the time window, unrelated similarly named products, and unsupported secondary reports were excluded.

### Review priority

No immediate review is recommended based on newly reported vulnerabilities in this scan window. Continue normal monitoring; older advisories were not relabeled as new.
